verdict.rationale: Programmatic control is a fair question for an authenticator app, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no documented public API for driving Google Authenticator: the docs describe only manual in-app actions (swipe, scan QR, drag). The GitHub HOTP/TOTP implementations and PAM module are developer building blocks, and rooted sqlite access is a user-side workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
